title: VirSME Platform | One Operating Environment for the Business
description: See how VirSME Core, Applications, AI and workflows create one connected operating environment for growing SMEs.
hero: One operating environment for the business behind the software.
intro: VirSME connects applications through one shared operating foundation so business context, workflows, permissions and AI can move with the work.

blocks.text: The platform is more than the sum of its modules.
Shared identity, organisation structure, permissions, records, relationships, events, auditability and search.
Connect, People, Work and Sales provide the established operating functions used by the business today.
A centralized intelligence and execution layer designed to understand business context, SOPs, policies, controls and authority structures.
Coordinates what should happen next across modules, including automated actions and human authorization points.
One entity. One record. Many authorised uses.
Employees, customers and other business entities should not require unrelated copies in every application. Shared records preserve context and reduce duplication.
The value is not simply that modules sit beside one another. The value is that records, events and business rules can connect the work between them.
Configured around how your business works
Processes, roles, approvals and controls should reflect the operating model of the business rather than forcing every business into the same generic process.
